DMA_FIFOStatus_3QuartersFull: if more than 3 quarters-full.
DMA_FIFOStatus_Empty: when FIFO is empty
DMA_FIFOStatus_Full: when FIFO is full

briefdescription.para: Returns the current BDMA Channel Global interrupt flag.
Get the DMA Stream pending flags.

parameterdescription.para:
Get the specified flag. This parameter can be any combination of the following values:
DMA_FLAG_TCIFx: Transfer complete flag.
DMA_FLAG_HTIFx: Half transfer complete flag.
DMA_FLAG_TEIFx: Transfer error flag.
DMA_FLAG_DMEIFx: Direct mode error flag.
DMA_FLAG_FEIFx: FIFO error flag. Where x can be 0_4, 1_5, 2_6 or 3_7 to select the DMA Stream flag.

briefdescription.para: Clear the DMA Stream pending flags.

parameterdescription.para:
specifies the flag to clear. This parameter can be any combination of the following values:
DMA_FLAG_TCIFx: Transfer complete flag.
DMA_FLAG_HTIFx: Half transfer complete flag.
DMA_FLAG_TEIFx: Transfer error flag.
DMA_FLAG_DMEIFx: Direct mode error flag.
DMA_FLAG_FEIFx: FIFO error flag. Where x can be 0_4, 1_5, 2_6 or 3_7 to select the DMA Stream flag.

briefdescription.para: Enable the specified DMA Stream interrupts.

parameterdescription.para:
specifies the DMA interrupt sources to be enabled or disabled. This parameter can be one of the following values:
DMA_IT_TC: Transfer complete interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_HT: Half transfer complete interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_TE: Transfer error interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_FE: FIFO error interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_DME: Direct mode error interrupt.

briefdescription.para: Disable the specified DMA Stream interrupts.

parameterdescription.para:
specifies the DMA interrupt sources to be enabled or disabled. This parameter can be one of the following values:
DMA_IT_TC: Transfer complete interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_HT: Half transfer complete interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_TE: Transfer error interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_FE: FIFO error interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_DME: Direct mode error interrupt.

briefdescription.para: Check whether the specified DMA Stream interrupt is enabled or not.

parameterdescription.para:
specifies the DMA interrupt source to check. This parameter can be one of the following values:
DMA_IT_TC: Transfer complete interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_HT: Half transfer complete interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_TE: Transfer error interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_FE: FIFO error interrupt mask.
DMA_IT_DME: Direct mode error interrupt.

briefdescription.para: Writes the number of data units to be transferred on the DMA Stream.

parameterdescription.para: Number of data units to be transferred (from 0 to 65535) Number of data items depends only on the Peripheral data format.

simplesect.para: If Peripheral data format is Bytes: number of data units is equal to total number of bytes to be transferred.
If Peripheral data format is Half-Word: number of data units is equal to total number of bytes to be transferred / 2.
If Peripheral data format is Word: number of data units is equal to total number of bytes to be transferred / 4.

parameterdescription.para: number of remaining data units in the current DMAy Streamx transfer.
